rows.grounds: compound stava+mātra in genitive relation expressing 'of a mere hymn'
object or subject denoting the greatness being described
compound vaktra+koṭi+śata indicating an immense number of mouths as instrument
emphatic particle intensifying the insufficiency of countless mouths

items.question: Can the greatness of a mere hymn be fully expressed even by countless mouths?
premises: The subject is the greatness of a mere hymn.
Hundreds of crores of mouths represent an immeasurable capacity for speech.
Even such immense expressive capacity is invoked as insufficient.
items.inference: The greatness of a mere hymn is beyond complete verbal expression.
uncertainties: The governing verb expressing impossibility or description is supplied from the surrounding context.
items.plain_english: Even with hundreds of crores of mouths, the greatness of a mere hymn cannot be fully expressed.
